capabilities: Assign a background preset to a pane
Remember presets per pane across file changes
Keep presets through splits, tab drags, and restarts
Reset all pane backgrounds to default
Expose preset picker via pane menu, command palette, or hotkey
disambiguation: Not a standalone appearance tool; it only adds a class and CSS variable per pane, and the SILVER Cat theme does the actual painting.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. No network use, no telemetry; settings stored in the plugin's own data.json. Not yet listed in the community directory, so manual install from release files is the current path.
intentEvidence: Made by @bkornpob as a companion to the SILVER Cat theme.
motivation: Made as a companion to the SILVER Cat theme, which is named for the author's cat SILVER.
problem: Obsidian's appearance settings apply one look to the whole workspace, so individual panes cannot be tinted differently or keep a tint when their file changes.

relations.evidence: Per-view background presets for the SILVER Cat theme.

summary: Companion plugin for the SILVER Cat theme that assigns a persistent background color preset to each pane in the main editor area.
